commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text: Even if what you eat is ambrosia, you shouldn’t want to eat it alone while a guest who came to you stays outside your home. It can also be read: even if some call eating once without a guest a medicine against death, leave it. These two couplets tell the excellence of caring for guests.
